enabled.description: Enable dnstracer service (i.e., whether to apply configuration)

dns_server.description: Initial DNS server to query (e.g., '8.8.8.8' or '.' for root servers)

query_class.description: DNS query class: one of A, AAAA, A6, SOA, CNAME, HINFO, MX, NS, TXT, PTR (case-insensitive)

retries.description: Number of retries for DNS requests

verbose.description: Enable verbose output showing what is sent/received

disable_local_cache.description: Disable local DNS caching (corresponds to '-c' flag)

overview.description: Show overview of received answers at end (corresponds to '-o' flag)

ipv4_only.description: Use only IPv4 servers, skip IPv6 (corresponds to '-4' flag)

source_address.description: Source IP address for outgoing packets (corresponds to '-S' flag)

targets.description:
List of domain/host names to trace (required positional argument(s))
Example: ['www.example.com'] or ['141.230.204.212.in-addr.arpa'] for PTR queries
